Path dependence/local optima: LLM agents satisfice to near trajectory (verbatim replay) rather than residual novelty; without calibrated abstention they prefer false_accept over UNKNOWN - motivates honest cost must include verification/abstention and 0-token replay baseline (prior)

Tool/API bypass is often higher leverage than DOM robustness - direct endpoint discovery (method+path+auth_scope) can shortcut entire sequences where selector healing only patches; distinguishes WebAPI catalog from hierarchical retrieval (prior)
Long-context retrieval success ≠ usage; provenance-bearing memory and context budgeting determine whether retrieval translates to action, especially on mixed header+body+query channels (prior)
Caching economics dominated by TTL/ETag validity window and DOM-hash fragility, not per-step model cost; heavy-tailed reuse but staleness invalidation determines amortization at f=10 (prior)

Self-generated subproblems risk tautology: synthetic alias families (query-param vs header) may be solved by adopting observed keys rather than true semantic resolution; requires production SPA titles/headers with genuine ambiguity (prior)
